freeze_statement: Re-freeze after the author-directed removal of the ChatGPT version from the disclosure. No number, rank, p-value, test, standing or registered outcome changes. The rule applied: do not publish a model number unless repository evidence conclusively establishes it. It does not -- the only occurrences in the tree are the author's own recollection, recorded verbatim AS unverified ('Catgut 5.5 / 5.6', AG-0007), and the restatement of it is the same uncertain pair. A pair cannot fill MDPI's prescribed '[tool name, version information]' slot, and an unsupported number is a specific checkable claim with nothing behind it, so the tool is named and its role described in full while the version is omitted rather than invented. This restores the D-0032 position and reverts the pass-32 attempt to state one. Four tracked files move, but only main.tex changes in substance: the rebuilt PDF, DOCX and cover letter are byte-identical to the pass-31 build, the sole surviving difference being a source comment recording the reasoning. Both supplementary artifacts are untouched. All five artifacts byte-identical across two consecutive builds at the pinned epochs; nine gates green.
